data.name: Green Suits
data.detailed_description:
GREEN SUITS — is a game about a squad of paranormal investigators, agents, psychics and charlatans. Build deep connections with your rascal comrades. Reveal a layered conspiracy, an otherworldly invasion, the struggle to define the next millennia, and don't lose your mind in the process!
But who will you be able to trust after that? Your Bureau? Your friends? Your eyes?

EACH BATTLE IS INFUSED WITH PERSONAL DRAMA

The heroes are prone to volatile emotional states like Happy, Sad, Angry, Frightened, Horny or Disgusted. Use them to your advantage, build powerful synergies with items, take emotional levels to the max but beware of their dangerous side effects.

Your agents carry acquired traumas and injuries represented as Personality Traits, which grant them new abilities and evolve dynamically based on your actions: cure a "Coward" trait by overcoming great danger, or watch a "Ruthless" hero become a "Rage Baiter" by making the rest of the party angry.

Investigate enemies intentions to execute precise block arithmetic and devastating counterattacks... Or risk it all and strike blindly.

data.short_description: In this dynamic drama-based JRPG you lead a squad of special agents and mediums against the global occult conglomerate as you investigate paranormal crimes and navigate surreal spaces. Turn-based battles defined by personal traumas, emotional states, block arithmetic and hidden intentions.
